faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial in Lesotho?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three straightforward tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is only billed after the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Can my bots continue running if my local internet goes down?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo agent runs inside its own isolated cloud container hosted in secure data centers, meaning tasks, web scraping, and scheduled routines proceed without interruption even if your phone or home connection loses power.

faq.q: How does Ceyo integrate with Telegram for team collaboration?
faq.a: You can connect bots as personal assistants or introduce multiple agents into group chats, where specialists coordinate with each other, query shared memory, and report findings directly in your team threads.

faq.q: Which languages and business tools are supported?
faq.a: Ceyo communicates fluently in English, understands multilingual regional context including Sesotho communications, and connects natively to over 1,000 workplace tools including Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and standard CRMs.

faq.q: Are my files and code safe within Ceyo cloud environments?
faq.a: Every bot operates within a strictly partitioned virtual machine with encrypted long-term memory and dedicated storage, ensuring your proprietary code, trade documents, and spreadsheets remain private.
